item.content:encoded:
This story strikes a wonderful, wonderful balance of making you hate Iceberg for how creepy he is, as well as making him a bit more sympathetic in some regards… somehow? I can't even place the exact text where it's happening, but it's definitely happening. This is a good place to start with Iceberg, especially when you get into his character more and see his relation with other researchers, especially Gears.

+1. Definitely underrated, and also a massive improvement from the original version. I almost wish I could find more stories with Iceberg as a central character, with this kind of characterization.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I actually really don't like this, despite the instinctive affections I have for relics.

And this is just a relic: not really up to par. It's kind of wanky and Iceberg's character creeping hard on Rights and Break isn't all that awesome; the point of the story appears to be that Iceberg is creepy and kinda very misogynist. It's not that we can't have creepy, misogynist characters, it's just that's all there is to this story. It's not enough. The main thing I like about this is the title and that doesn't really match the rest of the story.

Iceberg's character is more interesting and sympathetic when written by Troy.

Downvoting, but I'd vote for -ARC out of affection for old dead things.
